title: •Crash Site Memorial
caption: •Crash Site Memorial (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Dune Sea, Hutt Canyon, Jawa Camp, and Jawa Canyon are deserts. At deserts you occupy with a Jawa, Rontos and Sandcrawlers are power +1 and forfeit +2, and opponent’s Force generation is canceled. {alter}
lore: Mos Eisley was built around wreckage of the colony ship _Dowager Queen_. The wreck remains as a monument where residents leave junk for Jawa scavengers.
